articles.title: Five Ways NVIDIA Co-Design Maximizes the Value of Every Byte in the AI Factory | NVIDIA Technical Blog
articles.text:
In an AI factory, high bandwidth memory (HBM)is the fastest, most expensive, and most contested memory tier. Every byte spent on a redundant weight copy, an idle session’s KV cache, or a recomputed prefix is a byte that is not being used to produce tokens. The question is no longer how much memory a GPU has, but how much useful work each byte delivers.
The generational data in Figure 1 below shows why. From GB300 to NVIDIA Rubin, capacity held at 288 GB while bandwidth rose to 19.2 TB/s.
agentic throughput per megawatt grew far faster. On SemiAnalysis AgentX, which replays recorded coding-agent sessions with real tool-call gaps and growing context, NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 then delivers up to 30x the throughput per megawatt of GB300 NVL72 at 160 tokens per second per user.
Capacity alone cannot explain a 30x gain delivered from the same 288 GB per GPU. The difference is how much useful work each byte delivers.
NVIDIA treats this as a co-design problem that spans GPU architecture, the scale-up interconnect, serving software, the CPU, and storage. This post examines five ways that co-design maximizes the value of each byte of memory, from the bits that encode a single weight to the shared storage that preserves and reuses context across agentic turns and nodes.
1. How does NVFP4 store more intelligence in fewer bytes?
The most direct way to raise the value of a byte is to make each value smaller without losing what it encodes. NVFP4 does this with a 4-bit E2M1 element and two levels of scaling: Every 16-value micro-block shares an FP8 (E4M3) scale factor, and a per-tensor FP32 scale sits on top. The result is a format that is small enough to free significant HBM, yet granular enough to preserve accuracy where naive 4-bit formats fall short.
Applied to weights, NVFP4 reduces the model footprint by approximately 3.5x relative to FP16 and 1.8x relative to FP8, freeing memory for what agentic inference needs most: more KV-cache capacity, larger batches, and higher concurrency. NVFP4 has become the default precision for open agentic benchmarks with strict accuracy requirements, including AA-AgentPerf, SemiAnalysis AgentX, and MLPerf Endpoints. Across these benchmarks and leading mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, it delivers up to 4x the throughput of an FP8 baseline at the same interactivity (Figure 3 below).
The same principle extends to the KV cache itself. NVFP4 KV cache cuts the cache footprint by up to 50% compared with FP8, so approximately 2x more context stays resident on device. Fewer evictions mean higher cache-hit rates during prefill, while a smaller cache means less bandwidth consumed during decode.
NVFP4 shrinks the bytes. The next question is where those bytes live, and how many copies of them the AI factory has to keep.
2. How does the NVLink scale-up domain turn 72 GPUs into one memory pool?
MoE models activate only a subset of parameters per token, but every expert’s weights must still live somewhere in HBM. When experts are packed onto a small number of GPUs, each GPU spends a large share of its memory on weights, and each decode step pays a heavy weight-loading cost for the MoE GroupGEMMs. The bytes are resident, but they are not working hard.
Wide expert parallelism (Wide-EP) in NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM changes that ratio by spreading experts across eight or more GPUs. With DeepSeek-R1 at EP64, each GPU holds four experts per layer, or 232 expert blocks across 58 MoE layers out of 14,848 in the full model. Fewer expert weights per GPU means:
- Capacity: More HBM per GPU is left for KV cache, larger batches, and higher concurrency.
- Arithmetic intensity: GroupGEMM kernels reuse each loaded weight across more tokens, raising FLOPs per byte.
- Balance: The Expert Parallel Load Balancer (EPLB) redistributes hot and cold experts between forward passes, so no GPU’s memory is overcommitted while another sits idle.
This only works because the scale-up domain makes remote bytes nearly as useful as local ones. Every MoE layer triggers all-to-all dispatch and combine traffic, and without a high-bandwidth fabric, those collectives would erase the gains. On GB200 NVL72, 130 TB/s of aggregate NVLink bandwidth absorbs that traffic, and large EP (EP32) delivers up to 1.8x more output tokens per second per GPU than small EP (EP8) at 100 tokens per second per user.
Vera Rubin NVL72 extends the same design point. Each Rubin GPU brings up to 288 GB of HBM4 and 3.0 TB/s of NVLink 6 bandwidth, for roughly 20.7 TB of HBM4 across the rack. Rubin also adds inline memory tensor acceleratory (TMA) descriptor updates, so one shared descriptor can serve every expert with a common layout, reducing the metadata overhead that grows with expert count.
Wide-EP decides where weight bytes live. The next lever decides whether KV cache bytes, once computed, are ever computed again.
3. How does NVIDIA Dynamo make every cached byte count?
The key-value (KV) cache stores intermediate attention calculations from previously processed tokens so the model can reuse them instead of recomputing them. This inference state is ephemeral and can be evicted and recomputed when needed, but KV cache is only valuable if it is reused. Agentic workloads are full of reuse opportunities: system prompts, tool schemas, shared documents, and the growing history of a multistep task. But if a request lands on a GPU that does not hold its prefix, or if that prefix was evicted moments earlier, the system pays for prefill again. The bytes existed; they were just in the wrong place.
NVIDIA Dynamo is the distributed serving layer that closes this gap. It treats KV cache as a fleet-wide resource rather than a per-GPU side effect, and it does so through three co-designed capabilities:
- KV-aware routing: The Dynamo router tracks where KV blocks reside and considers both cached-prefix overlap and worker load when placing requests. It balances existing context against the cost of sending work to an utilized GPU and turns potential recomputations into cache hits.
- Disaggregated serving: Prefill and decode run on separate GPU pools, each sized for its own compute and memory profile. Decode GPUs can dedicate HBM to KV cache and batch size rather than reserving headroom for bursty prefill.
- KV Cache Runner (KVCR): This tracks where every block lives across configured GPU, pinned CPU, and storage tiers, including local SSDs and mounted network filesystems. A prefix preserved outside HBM can be restored when a later request needs it, allowing useful context to survive GPU eviction and continue saving prefill work. KVCR uses the NVIDIA Inference Xfer Library (NIXL) for its storage-transfer paths, allowing cached blocks to move while the GPU processes other work. KVCR also enables distributed reuse, with router-provided hints helping a selected worker retrieve cached context from a peer, while the inference engine retains control of GPU memory and local host offloading. The additional KVCR-Guard feature preserves committed KVCR-managed host-memory cache across an engine failure as long as the guard service and host remain available.
Dynamo’s KV-cache offloading depends on fast retrieval: Preserving a prefix outside HBM saves time when loading it is faster than repeating prefill. NIXL connects this offloading path to external storage systems. In separate validation tests, storage vendors VAST Data and WEKA demonstrated 35 GB/s to one H100 GPU using GPUDirect Storage and up to 270 GB/s of aggregate read throughput across eight H100 GPUs through a custom NIXL plugin, respectively. These tests showed that external storage could supply KV cache to the tested GPU systems without becoming the transfer bottleneck, supporting cache capacity beyond HBM. A separate VAST test demonstrated the response-time benefit: Using vLLM and LMCache on a DGX H100 system, loading stored KV cache instead of recomputing it reduced time to first token for Qwen3-32B with a 130K-token prompt.
Dynamo coordinates where cached bytes go and when they come back. The next two levers expand the capacity available for that context, starting with CPU memory.
4. How does the NVIDIA Vera CPU keep idle context from wasting HBM?
Agentic inference does not run in one uninterrupted pass. A single session alternates between GPU model steps and CPU-side work: tool calls, code execution, retrieval, database queries, and sandboxed evaluation. During each of those gaps, any session KV cache retained in HBM occupies capacity without serving active token generation, while other requests compete for the same bytes.
In a fully subscribed AI factory, the GPU does not wait. It takes on new requests while the tool call runs, and the longer the gap, the more likely the original session’s KV cache is evicted to make room. When the tool returns, the GPU may have to rebuild that context through a full prefill rather than resume from a cached state. A slow CPU therefore costs HBM twice: first as idle residency, then as recomputation.
The NVIDIA Vera CPU attacks both sides of this problem:
- Shorter gaps: 88 Olympus cores deliver 1.8x faster single-threaded performance, 40% lower peak loaded latency than x86 CPUs, and up to 14 GB/s of memory bandwidth per core. Faster, more predictable tool calls shrink the window in which KV cache is exposed to eviction pressure.
- A fast place to park context: Each Vera CPU provides up to 1.5 TB of LPDDR5X, more than 5x the HBM4 capacity of a single Rubin GPU. NVIDIA NVLink-C2C connects it coherently to Rubin at 1.8 TB/s, roughly 7x the 256 GB/s of an x16 PCIe Gen 6 link.
Together, these capabilities change the economics of an idle session. Instead of holding its KV cache in HBM or discarding it, Dynamo’s KV Block Manager can stage it in Vera memory for the duration of the tool call and bring it back over NVLink-C2C when the agent resumes. HBM stays dedicated to sessions that are actively generating tokens, and the paused session avoids paying for prefill twice.
Vera memory is the warm tier, sized for context that will return within a turn. For context that must survive across turns, agents, and nodes, the AI factory needs a tier that is larger still.
5. How does NVIDIA CMX extend context memory across the pod?
Keeping every reusable KV-cache byte in GPU or host memory limits capacity for active inference, but discarding it can force recomputation.. Multi-turn sessions, long-horizon tasks, and multi-agent workflows that share working memory all generate KV cache that will be needed again, often minutes later and often on a different node. Longer context windows and more concurrent sessions increase KV-cache capacity requirements beyond GPU HBM (G1 in Figure 9 below) and host memory (G2). The traditional hierarchy was not designed for this data. Local SSDs (G3) are bound to one node, while shared enterprise storage (G4) is built for durable data and carries replication and metadata overhead that ephemeral KV cache does not need.
NVIDIA CMX context memory storage closes this gap with a new G3.5 tier: Ethernet-attached flash, shared at the pod level, and optimized specifically for KV cache. It is built on the NVIDIA STX reference design and co-designed across four layers:
- Storage processing: The NVIDIA BlueField-4 STX Storage Processor manages the NVMe SSDs, runs storage services, and offloads KV-cache data movement, data integrity and encryption. Its integrated NVIDIA Vera CPU accelerates CPU-side storage processing, extending the same CPU architecture used for agent execution into the storage data path.
- Networking: NVIDIA Spectrum-X Ethernet provides low-latency, high-bandwidth RDMA access between compute nodes and CMX storage nodes.
- KV-aware services: NVIDIA DOCA Memos provides KV-aware services and I/O control on BlueField-4, treating context as a first-class resource for placement and sharing.
- Serving integration: Dynamo and NIXL make CMX appear as one seamless context tier across the pod, prestaging context and routing requests to where KV cache already resides.
The pod-level design is what raises the value of each byte. A prefix computed once on one node can be reused across compatible model instances in the pod, so agents that share documents, tools, or working memory can avoid duplicate prefill. Pooling context storage across the pod reduces KV-cache duplication and stranded capacity across nodes, extending effective GPU memory for inference. By prestaging reusable context into GPU or host memory, CMX reduces inference stalls, while its KV-cache-optimized storage tier lowers the power overhead of serving that context. Together, these capabilities help CMX deliver up to 5x higher tokens per second and up to 5x better power efficiency compared with traditional storage for long-context inference.
How do the five levers work together?
Each lever removes a different kind of waste. NVFP4 removes bits a value does not need, Wide-EP removes redundant weight copies, Dynamo removes recomputation, Vera removes idle residency during tool calls, and CMX enables KV-cache sharing and reuse across nodes. Because these levers are designed as one memory system, not as independent parts, the gains stack: A 4-bit KV block saves space in HBM, in Vera memory, and in CMX alike.
The result is an AI factory that measures memory not by capacity alone, but by the useful tokens each byte produces. Vera Rubin NVL72 shows what that looks like: up to 30x the throughput per megawatt of GB300 NVL72, from the same 288 GB per GPU. As agentic workloads grow, every byte counts.
Learn more
This work was made possible through the expertise and engineering contributions of Wei-ming Chen, Shiyang Chen, Chao Ni, Mengdi Wang, and Jeff Pool.

articles.title: Reddit testet Search Ads, baut neue Feeds ein und plant eine Login-Pflicht – was dahintersteckt
articles.text:
Neue Feeds, Login-Pläne, Search Ads: Warum Reddit gerade so viel an seiner Plattform verändert
Eine Community für Communitys oder doch eine Suchmaschine? Reddit möchte beides sein und wird derzeit einem großen Wandel unterzogen. Schon 2025 erklärte CEO Steve Huffman, Reddit zu einer „Go-to-Suchmaschine“ machen zu wollen. Mit Features wie einer Suchleiste im Home-Feed, Related Answers unter Posts und den KI-gestützten Reddit Answers wurde diesem Vorhaben schon Rechnung getragen. Huffmann sagte dazu vergangenes Jahr:
Reddit is one of the few platforms positioned to become a true search destination. We offer something special: a breadth of conversations and knowledge you can’t find anywhere else. Every week, hundreds of millions of people come to Reddit looking for advice, and we’re turning more of that intent into active users of Reddit’s native search […].
Reddit zählt derzeit 515 Millionen wöchentlich aktive User. Und nach eigenen Angaben gibt die Hälfte der User an, dass Reddit ihnen bei der Entdeckung neuer Dinge hilft. Immerhin hat Reddit auch über 100.000 aktive Communitys und mehr als 27 Milliarden Posts und Kommentare zu bieten. Während die Plattform die Search-Erfahrung sowie die grundlegende Plattformnutzung für die User weiter ausbaut, soll Werbung in der Suche künftig zur Reddit-Experience gehören. Die ersten Tests laufen schon und geben Advertisern Hoffnung. Reddit selbst könnte damit das eigene Geschäft ankurbeln, nachdem es dafür zuletzt kleine Dämpfer gegeben hat.
Wo die User auf Reddit Search Ads sehen
In einem Blog-Beitrag erklärt Reddit, dass neuerdings Search Ads direkt zwischen den Suchergebnissen auf der Plattform getestet werden. Ausgewählte Advertiser haben Zugriff auf die Option. Eine Ausweitung ist geplant, aber noch nicht terminiert.
Mit den neuen Search-Ads können Advertiser basierend auf bestehenden Targeting-Optionen User unmittelbar auf Suchergebnisseiten erreichen – wie diese es von Google und inzwischen auch von ChatGPT gewohnt sind. Dabei erscheinen die Reddit-Search-Ads auf Basis verschiedener Faktoren. Im Zentrum steht die kontextuelle Relevanz zur Suchanfrage, quasi wie bei einer Keyword- oder Keyphrase-Match-Funktion. Reddit liefert zwei Beispiele:
- Wer nach einer Espresso-Station (Tamperstation) sucht, könnte Ads zu Espressomaschinen, zu Tassen oder auch zu Espresso- oder Kaffeebohnen erhalten.
- Wer nach einem Homeoffice-Set-up sucht, könnte Ads für Monitore, Tische oder Bürostühle erhalten.
Die ausgespielten Ads erscheinen mitten zwischen organischen Suchergebnissen auf der Ergebnisseite. Sie zeigen ein Visual, einen CTA‑Button und ein Favicon sowie die Domain und den Namen des Advertisers. Ein Label markiert die Werbung, wenngleich dieses klein im Header anstelle eines Veröffentlichungszeitpunkts steht.
Search-Ads könnten Reddit dabei helfen, das eigene Werbegeschäft auf Basis der umfassenden Nutzung – immer stieg die Zahl der wöchentlich aktiven User im Jahresvergleich um 16 Prozent – zu fördern. Im dritten Quartal 2026 stieg der Werbeumsatz year over year um 54 Prozent auf 847 Millionen US-Dollar an (bei 895 Millionen Gesamtumsatz). Der Gewinn des Unternehmens stieg sogar um 74 Prozent auf 283 Millionen US-Dollar an.
Und doch reagierte die Börse auf die Quartalszahlen mit einem Kurseinbruch. Denn Reddit konnte die Erwartungen bei den User-Zahlen nicht erfüllen und der Ausblick auf das vierte Quartal sorgt ebenfalls für Unmut bei Anleger:innen, weil die Prognosen der Analyst:innen womöglich nicht eintreffen werden. Da kommen große Veränderungen an der Plattform gelegen, um langfristig doch noch mehr User und Advertiser für sich gewinnen zu können.
Neben Search Ads: Neue Feeds und Login-Zwang als maßgebliche Änderungen
Reddit befindet sich nicht nur aufgrund der immer neuen KI-Funktionen auf der Plattform im Wandel. Die Community für Communitys möchte sich für Advertiser, aber auch User attraktiver denn je darstellen. Deshalb führte Reddit kürzlich einen „For You“- und einen „Following“-Feed für mehr Kontrolle über das eigene Plattformerlebnis ein. Damit orientiert sich die Plattform an Tiktok und Instagram. Zuletzt wurden außerdem Video- und Audioversionen von Reddit-Posts getestet, um sich dem durch Tiktoks und Reels geprägten Rezeptionsverhalten anzunähern.
Und damit die User auf Reddit wirklich als aktive User verzeichnet sind, plant das Unternehmen laut Axios eine Login-Pflicht, um umfassende Inhalte rezipieren zu können. Das soll das unerlaubte Content-Scraping einschränken, dem User-Wachstum helfen, aber ebenso das Werbegeschäft stärken. Laut Reddit-COO Jen Wong ist die Aktivität angemeldeter User etwa fünfmal so hoch wie die von Usern ohne Login. Sie generieren dadurch mehr Werbeeinblendungen und sind für das Unternehmen wirtschaftlich besonders wertvoll. Wie Reddit im aktuellen Quartalsbericht erklärt, entfallen schon mehr als 80 Prozent der Monetarisierung auf die App und angemeldete User. Durch die geplanten Einschränkungen könnte Reddit künftig mehr Besucher:innen zur Anmeldung bewegen und deren Interessen für personalisierte Empfehlungen und gezieltere Werbung nutzen. Solch eine Login-Notwendigkeit soll zuerst in den USA kommen.
Mit einem spezifischen Alleinstellungsmerkmal möchte sich Reddit derweil von anderen Plattformen und Suchdiensten unterscheiden. Kevin Klieber, Head of Mid-Market Sales DACH bei Reddit, erklärte gegenüber OnlineMarketing.de:
KI, Suchmaschinen und soziale Plattformen liefern heute unglaublich gute Antworten. Doch Menschen suchen inzwischen nach etwas anderem: Sicherheit für ihre Entscheidungen durch die Erfahrungen anderer Menschen. Genau deshalb ist Reddit heute so relevant. […] Je stärker das Internet von Algorithmen, KI-generierten Inhalten und kuratierten Feeds geprägt wird, desto wertvoller werden authentische Gespräche zwischen echten Menschen.
Der Artikel stammt von Niklas Lewanczik aus der OnlineMarketing.de-Redaktion und wird im Rahmen einer Content-Kooperation auf t3n veröffentlicht.

articles.title: OpenAI president says AI could make death a choice, predicts major medical breakthroughs within 18 months
articles.text:
Big quote: We're still waiting for AI to cure cancer, not to mention the many other things we were promised it would bring. But OpenAI co-founder and president Greg Brockman is boldly confident that the technology will one day cure all that ails us – to the point that death could even become a choice.
Speaking at WSJ Tech, Brockman said the huge medical advancements we're still waiting for AI to enable will happen in the next year to year and a half.
"Having cures for diseases is something that's become also a trope in this field, but I think that you're gonna see real delivery and real significant strides and impacts on biology, health, and curing of diseases over the next 12 months, 18 months," he said.
"I think that we all suffer, that the question of even just thinking about death becoming a choice. All of this is possible."
Being OpenAI's president means Brockman is always going to laud AI as potentially allowing us to live forever, while the promise of huge breakthroughs in the next 12 to 18 months has been around since ChatGPT launched.
 – Fireside Alpha (@firesidealpha) November 5, 2026
But Brockman isn't alone when it comes to faith in AI's future medical applications. Last month, Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar claimed that many AI researchers are so sure the technology will cure cancer one day that they've taken up smoking. He referred to this as a "kind of this mass psychosis social delusion."
Others in the tech industry share similar beliefs. Futurist Peter Diamandis said last year that the key to living much longer is to not die "from something stupid" before 2030, after which point a combination of technologies, with AI the driving force, will help us achieve "longevity escape velocity."
Bryan Johnson, the biohacker millionaire famed for trying to fight off aging, said AI is one of the technologies that could ensure no condition is presumed incurable.
Then there's Elon Musk. He said this year that longevity or semi-immortality is an extremely solvable problem because the body ages in sync. He said nobody has an old left arm and a young right arm, so we are programmed to die, but we could change that programming to live longer.
 – Fireside Alpha (@firesidealpha) November 1, 2026
Curing diseases like cancer and making death an option, however, still feels like the stuff of fantasy. But perhaps these sorts of promises will distract people complaining about "compute campuses," or data centers, as they are and always shall be called.

articles.title: Canva anuncia el despido del 22 % de su plantilla por el avance de la IA: la medida afectará a 1.271 empleados
articles.text:
Canva anunció una profunda reestructuración de su organización que afectará a 1.271 trabajadores, equivalentes al 22 % de su plantilla. La compañía australiana, conocida por su plataforma de diseño gráfico en línea, justificó los cambios por la transformación que está provocando la inteligencia artificial (IA) en la industria del software y la necesidad de adaptar su estructura a esta nueva etapa tecnológica.
La decisión fue comunicada por Melanie Perkins, directora ejecutiva y cofundadora de la empresa, mediante una nota dirigida a los empleados y publicada el miércoles en el sitio web de Canva. El proceso contempla despidos, cambios de funciones y traslados de trabajadores hacia centros de trabajo centrales.
Aunque la compañía confirmó que más de una quinta parte de su equipo se verá afectada, no precisó cuántas personas perderán definitivamente sus empleos. La reorganización también incluye modificaciones en la distribución de sus equipos y en la modalidad de trabajo de sus empleados.
Perkins describió la decisión como uno de los momentos más difíciles en los 13 años de historia de la empresa. Según explicó, los cambios tecnológicos están modificando la manera en que las personas crean contenido y utilizan las herramientas digitales, por lo que considera necesario realizar una transformación interna más profunda.
Por qué Canva está despidiendo empleados por el avance de la IA
La inteligencia artificial está modificando el funcionamiento de las empresas de software. Las nuevas herramientas permiten realizar tareas que antes requerían programas especializados o conocimientos técnicos, lo que está cambiando la forma en que los usuarios producen diseños, documentos y otros contenidos digitales.
Canva busca adaptarse a este escenario mediante una estructura organizativa más sencilla, con equipos pequeños y autónomos que puedan desarrollar productos y tomar decisiones con mayor rapidez.
“Las nuevas tecnologías están transformando lo que las personas pueden crear, cómo lo crean y qué esperan de los productos que utilizan”, escribió Perkins en el comunicado. También reconoció que llegó a la conclusión de que los cambios graduales ya no eran suficientes para responder a las nuevas condiciones del mercado.
La ejecutiva explicó que la empresa reducirá las especializaciones en nichos de mercado y reorganizará sus áreas para concentrar más responsabilidades en equipos de menor tamaño.
El movimiento refleja una tendencia que también alcanza a otras compañías tecnológicas: utilizar inteligencia artificial para automatizar procesos, acelerar el desarrollo de productos y realizar tareas con menos trabajadores.
Canva también modificará su modalidad de trabajo
La reestructuración no se limitará a los despidos. La compañía anunció que Sídney, Australia, se convertirá en el principal centro de operaciones para una mayor cantidad de equipos de producto.
Además, habrá cambios en la modalidad de trabajo de los empleados. A partir de enero, la mayoría de los trabajadores que actualmente tienen un esquema híbrido deberán asistir a las oficinas entre dos y tres días por semana.
La medida busca fortalecer la colaboración presencial y facilitar la coordinación entre los equipos que desarrollan las herramientas de la plataforma.
Canva fue fundada por Melanie Perkins, Cliff Obrecht y Cameron Adams. Desde su lanzamiento, se convirtió en una de las plataformas de diseño más utilizadas por personas sin formación profesional en diseño gráfico, gracias a sus plantillas y herramientas de edición simplificadas.
La reestructuración llega en medio de cambios en el valor de Canva
Los despidos también se producen mientras la compañía atraviesa una etapa de ajustes en su crecimiento y prepara el terreno para una posible salida a bolsa.
En 2021, Canva alcanzó una valoración cercana a los 40.000 millones de dólares. Sin embargo, un año después su valor cayó hasta aproximadamente 26.000 millones de dólares, en medio de una ola de ventas que afectó a numerosas empresas tecnológicas.
Aunque posteriormente recuperó parte de su valoración, el impacto de los cambios recientes en el sector todavía genera incertidumbre entre los inversores.
El contexto también está marcado por el temor a que las nuevas herramientas de inteligencia artificial reduzcan la necesidad de utilizar programas tradicionales. Empresas como Anthropic, con su asistente Claude, están desarrollando tecnologías capaces de ejecutar tareas que antes requerían aplicaciones especializadas.
Esta transformación ha provocado que los inversores revisen sus expectativas sobre el futuro de las compañías de software y la rentabilidad de sus modelos de negocio.

articles.title: Cisco, WatchGuard Release Patches; SonicWall Won’t Fix GMS Flaws
articles.text:
Cisco and WatchGuard this week announced patches for a handful of vulnerabilities in their products, including remote code execution (RCE) and authentication flaws.
WatchGuard published five advisories, including four describing critical-severity bugs. The most severe is CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS score of 9.8), a use-after-free issue in the IPv4 networking code of the Linux kernel.
Fireware OS and WatchGuard AP contain the vulnerable Linux kernel versions, but are not affected by the RCE exploit chain it opens the door to. Dimension runs a vulnerable Ubuntu version, but patches are not available yet, WatchGuard says.
The company rolled out fixes for three critical authentication issues (CVE-2026-121639, CVE-2026-121638, and CVE-2026-121640) and a high-severity integrity validation bug (CVE-2026-121637) in AuthPoint Authentication Gateway.
Cisco released fixes for CVE-2026-76506, a high-severity vulnerability in UCS Central Software that could allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely or leak information.
Both WatchGuard and Cisco say they are not aware of any of these vulnerabilities being exploited in the wild.
On Wednesday, Cisco also updated its advisory on CVE-2026-111497, dubbed Node2Shell, HTTP2Shell, and Broccoli2Shell, the exploited out-of-bounds write flaw in Google’s Brotli data compression library that organizations have been scrambling to patch.
Per the updated advisory, 19 Cisco products are affected by Node2Shell, and the company is still investigating dozens more. The security defect also impacts nearly a dozen Splunk products.
This week, SonicWall warned that its legacy centralized management platform Global Management System (GMS), which reached End-of-Life (EOL) in October 2025, is affected by two vulnerabilities that will remain unpatched.
The first, CVE-2026-109593, is a critical-severity file read bug that can be exploited without authentication, while the second, CVE-2026-109594, is a medium-severity SQL injection that could allow attackers to access and modify information in the GMS database.

articles.title: Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door Coupe first drive: Where tech and fun collide
articles.text:
The night before I drove the AMG GT 4-Door Coupe, I complained to a group of journalists that automakers don’t want to take chances and just build fun, weird cars anymore. About 12 hours later, Mercedes made me eat my words. Outside of all the bombastic extravaganza of the Los Angeles launch, the first true AMG powered exclusively by batteries is a technological triumph that’s as comfortable on the track as it is on the street. And it’s really very good on the track.
Triforce
One of the fundamental problems with EVs is weight. Batteries are heavy, and the old rule about an object in motion tending to stay in motion makes the notion of nimble cornering a difficult engineering problem. Mercedes loves an engineering problem, and after two days behind the wheel of the AMG GT EV, the company has mostly reduced the battery-weight tax that mires EV performance.
On the road and on the track, the vehicle is firmly planted to the roadway. Mercedes says various technologies make this possible. In addition to decades of producing high-performance vehicles, the automaker’s AMG.EA sports-car architecture does a lot of heavy lifting here, constantly adjusting power delivery from the three motors while guiding the Active Ride Control suspension, steering—including up to 6 degrees at the rear axle—and active aerodynamics to deliver the performance AMG customers have come to expect from a vehicle with the Affalterbach badge on the hood.
An exploded view of the axial flux motor.
Roberto Baldwin
An exploded view of the axial flux motor.
Roberto Baldwin
One of the AMG GT 4-Door Coupe’s battery cells.
Roberto Baldwin
One of the AMG GT 4-Door Coupe’s battery cells.
Roberto Baldwin
An exploded view of the axial flux motor.
Roberto Baldwin
One of the AMG GT 4-Door Coupe’s battery cells.
Roberto Baldwin
Of the technology added to the vehicle, the axial flux motors are the most intriguing. Three motors offer a lighter, smaller powertrain that unlocks a host of abilities: two that are 3.1 inches (79 mm) wide in the back, one that’s 3.5 inches (89 mm) wide in the front. Produced by Yasa, which Mercedes bought in 2021, the motors output up to 1,153 hp (860 kW) of peak power in the AMG GT 63, with a nominal output of 711 hp (530 kW) and 1,475 lb-ft (2,000 Nm). During Boost mode, the additional horsepower is available for 63 seconds—because it’s the AMG GT 63, obviously.
The AMG GT 55’s Boost mode lasts for 55 seconds, with a peak output of 805 hp (634 kW). The 55’s nominal output is 557 hp (415 kW) and 1,372 lb-ft (1,860 Nm) of torque. I was able to use the Boost modes of both trim levels multiple times in a row without issue. Indeed, zero to 60 mph (97 km/h) takes about 2.3 seconds, and zero to 124 mph (200 km/h) around 6.8 seconds.
Which means on track you can arrive at a corner going really quite fast.
The styling at the rear is… challenging.
Credit:
Mercedes-AMG
The styling at the rear is… challenging.
Credit:
Mercedes-AMG
Thankfully, the AMG GT’s speed can be tamed with regenerative braking and hydraulic brake-by-wire friction brakes: carbon ceramic discs at the front and steel ones at the rear. The system offered incredible stopping power when I decided to push the vehicle on the track and hit the brakes far too late for a tight left-hand corner. The deceleration was solid even as the vehicle was cresting a hill when I applied the brakes.
For drivers looking for an extreme amount of control over their vehicle, there’s the AMG race engineer control system (standard on the 63, optional on the 55) that consists of three dials in the center console: Response, Agility, Traction. They all go up to nine, which is a shame, because they could have added two more levels of control. At one, the settings are essentially for new drivers who really shouldn’t be behind the wheel of this vehicle. At nine, everything is turned up to (well, I’d like to say 11) the limit, and it’s a great way to fully unleash everything the vehicle has to offer and spend the day melting tires and struggling to keep the vehicle pointed forward around corners.
On the track, they had us dial it up to seven, which loosened up the rear end and increased throttle response to a level where we easily broke traction at the rear. Regardless of skill level, it’s a fun tool for track days where you can dial in exactly how you want the vehicle to respond.
Twist for fun.
Credit:
Roberto Baldwin
Twist for fun.
Credit:
Roberto Baldwin
Charging forward
Mercedes has moved to an 800 V system with the AMG GT 4-Door Coupe (yes, it’s a long name, but it distinguishes it from the current V8-powered AMG GT). The electrical architecture offers increased efficiencies and quicker charging, but because this is an AMG GT and it’s the automaker’s halo electric vehicle, they’ve decided to push the boat out and enable it to DC fast-charge at up to 600 kW. In a demo, one of the track AMG GT 63 vehicles hit a peak of 637 kW. At 60 percent state of charge, the car was drawing about 400 kW, and at 79 percent it was still pulling 252 kW. The vehicle went from 17 to 80 percent in about 10 minutes.
Charging quickly is great, but the same cooling technology in that battery pack also allows repeated Boost mode sessions. Mercedes is cooling its cylindrical batteries with a non-conductive oil that first flows by the connectors and then circles back past the center of the battery before returning to be cooled. Mercedes would not comment on the chemistry of the oil it uses, calling it a “secret.”
Mercedes has not shared range targets for the 106 kWh battery pack.
That sound
The driver’s displays are canted toward them.
Credit:
Mercedes-AMG
The driver’s displays are canted toward them.
Credit:
Mercedes-AMG
I want to hate the sound. I want to bat it away as a gimmick meant to appease drivers still clinging to a world of V8 power and loud exhausts.
Instead, the roar of the AMG GT R (C190 generation) comes flooding out of the speakers and activates actuators in the seats, and it’s delightful. It won me over, and the sound placement in the cabin re-creates a sort of mid-engine location for my brain. The result is, I’m driving an all-electric AMG with a fake mid-engine V8 noise, and I’m having fun.
The V8 growl appears when you walk up to the vehicle and when it’s turned on. In Comfort, Sport, and Race mode, it’s gone, but in Sport+, it rears its throaty head. When the vehicle is placed into Boost mode, the V8 noise gets louder (as it should).
It doesn’t sound real. It sounds close to real. It’s the difference between listening to a cassette tape of your favorite band and going to see them live. There’s an audio fidelity that’s not quite there, particularly in the low end. But you still enjoy that tape. It’s not necessary, but it’s delightful.
Inside (or finally a use for the passenger screen)
The interior is outfitted with all the luxury bits you expect from a Mercedes. All the usual suspects are there: the quilted door panels, the comfortable seats, and the array of available materials. This includes the screens and, yeah, the passenger screen.
Now this is useful information on a passenger screen.
Credit:
Roberto Baldwin
Now this is useful information on a passenger screen.
Credit:
Roberto Baldwin
But I finally found a use for that screen. It can display all the technical information of the vehicle, including nerdy data points about the amount of Nm a motor is outputting. I’ll never watch a video or play a video game on that screen outside of testing the latest version of MBUX 4.0, but I will stare at it while it shares details about the vehicle.
The seats are very comfortable, and the lumbar support and side bolsters are controlled on-screen. Usually I find this annoying, but the level of fine-tuning this affords the driver and passenger is impressive, and I’ll give it a pass. Also, at 6 feet, 3 inches (1.9 m), I fit comfortably in the back seat. The large trunk should allow for a group of four to head out for a nice weekend away. Or maybe pick up the kids from soccer practice.
Kids love fun. Adults love fun. At least they should. Mercedes-AMG built a fun but very expensive vehicle. The AMG GT 55 starts at $145,000 (destination is an additional $1,550) and will be available by the end of the year. The AMG GT 63 starts at $175,000 (destination fee unavailable at this time) and will be available at the beginning of 2027. Regardless of the 401(k)-emptying price, the electric coupe should squelch the “all EVs drive the same” discourse.
A coupe can have four doors, because it just means “cut” in French, as in the roofline has been cut.
Credit:
Mercedes-AMG
A coupe can have four doors, because it just means “cut” in French, as in the roofline has been cut.
Credit:
Mercedes-AMG
The AMG-GT Four-Door Coupe delivers the promise of an AMG as an EV that drips with nerdy and driver joy that can also get very, very sideways.

articles.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Anthropic announced Thursday that Claude is getting a new tool called “Personal Finance,” designed to help users keep track of their money. With it, users can connect their bank and credit card accounts through Plaid and ask Claude questions about their finances. Anthropic says access is read-only, meaning Personal Finance can’t move, manage, or invest users’ money.
By letting Claude connect directly to bank and credit card accounts, Anthropic is positioning its chatbot as a financial companion that can help people understand their spending and make sense of their money, rather than simply offering them generic advice.
With the launch, Claude is playing catch-up to OpenAI’s ChatGPT, which introduced similar personal finance tools in May that also let users connect their financial accounts and ask questions about everything from spending patterns to long-term financial planning.
“Claude gives you answers in everyday language, from your balances and transactions, and explains any term that’s new to you,” Anthropic wrote in a blog post. “Like the rest of Claude, Personal Finance has no ads or sponsored recommendations, and it doesn’t offer credit cards, loans, or savings accounts of its own, so your money questions get a straight answer.”
For instance, at the end of the month, a user could ask Claude, “Where did my money go this month?” The chatbot will then add up spending across the connected accounts and sort it by category, such as rent and utilities, food and drink, and shopping. Users can choose to go deeper by following up with questions like, “Is that more than usual?” or “Anything else I’m missing?”
Anthropic says the tool goes beyond basic spending summaries by analyzing transactions across connected accounts to flag potential issues, such as duplicate charges, unexpected fees, and steadily increasing bills. Users can also ask broader questions about their finances, such as whether they’re spending more than they earn. The tool can also explain financial concepts like APR (annual percentage rate), while providing calculations that show users how much they’ve paid in interest over the past year.
Of course, some people will have reservations about connecting their financial accounts to an AI chatbot. Anthropic says Claude’s access is limited to each connected bank’s name, account name and type, the last four digits of the account number, balances, credit limits, and up to two years of transaction history.
Additionally, the company notes that when users chat with Claude in the Personal Finance hub, those conversations aren’t used to train its models.
Personal Finance starts rolling out in beta this week to users on the Pro, Max, and Ultra plans in the U.S.
The launch of the new tool comes as Anthropic has been expanding Claude into new verticals. For instance, Anthropic launched Claude for Legal and Claude for Financial Services earlier this year.

articles.title: The New York Times is in talks to buy Letterboxd for around $330 million
articles.text:
The New York Times Company is in talks”exclusive negotations” to acquire Letterboxd, the social network for film lovers, for around $330 million, The New York Times reports. The Times Company, Sony Pictures Entertainment, and A24 were all recently rumored to be among those interested in buying Letterboxd.
The New York Times is in talks to buy Letterboxd for around $330 million
Rumors have been swirling about the film lover’s social network for a while, but the NYT reports it’s the buyer.
The negotiations with the Times Company have included the potential for Letterboxd’s co-founders to stay in charge but report to a Times Company executive. Letterboxd would likely remain standalone for the “foreseeable future,” according to the NYT. The company would also integrate the Times Company’s ad tech.
NYT spokesperson Charlie Stadtlander declined to comment. Letterboxd and current parent company Tiny Ltd. didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment from The Verge.
If the NYT does acquire Letterboxd, it would follow other major purchases like Wordle (in a deal in “the low seven figures”), Wirecutter (“slightly more than $30 million”), and The Athletic ($550 million).

articles.title: GhostMap Android flaw lets malicious app trigger persistent boot loop
articles.text:
Attackers can force Android devices into a continuous boot loop using a specially crafted app that requires no permissions and only needs to be installed.
To cause the persistent denial-of-service (DoS), the app triggers a vulnerability that researchers dubbed 'GhostMap' that makes Android map a file into an unallocated memory region. The affected process crashes when it attempts to read from that region.
Romanian cybersecurity company Bitdefender discovered the flaw while analyzing an Android banking trojan that kept crashing its emulators when it tried to read an application resource.
The researchers demonstrated the vulnerability by creating an app that contains no executable code, requests no permissions on installation, and does not need to be launched on the device.
According to the company, Google has been aware of GhostMap since August but closed the issue without releasing a patch, classifying it as "not reproducible."
Making phones unusable
In a report today, Bitdefender explains that GhostMap stems from two Android libraries that interpret ZIP compression methods differently. This allows a malformed APK (Android package file) to bypass size checks and be mapped beyond the file’s actual contents.
"Reading such an entry causes a SIGBUS (a signal sent by the CPU to stop a process that accesses an invalid memory space) in whichever process touches the file," the researchers say.
To demonstrate the crash-loop effect, Bitdefender created an app containing a resource that the core Android service ‘system_server’ automatically attempts to read after installation.
The read triggers the flaw and restarts the process, causing it to read the same resource and crash again in an endless loop.
During the tests, the researchers used a Pixel 10 device running Android 17 with the August 5 security patch. The device started the crash string about one second after installing the app, the loop repeating for 110 times in normal boot mode and 72 times in safe mode.
Bitdefender warns that the boot loop also prevents users from accessing Safe Mode, which would normally provide a way to troubleshoot the problem and restore the device.
Stopping the crashes is possible in two ways: a factory reset, which erases all locally stored data, and by deleting the malformed file via ADB.
However, using ADB requires the debugging option to already be active on the device. Additionally, restoring via ADB requires the scripts to act before the system crashes.
Google’s response
Bitdefender reported the issue to Google on August 20, but received a “Won’t Fix (Not Reproducible)” reply, with the issue being out of scope.
The researchers submitted an extended version on August 25, believing Google misclassified the original report. The tech giant still deemed it out of scope for a security update, though it reserved it for consideration in a future update.
BleepingComputer has reached out to Google asking about the fix status for GhostMap, but we are still waiting for a reply.
Bitdefender says the only chance to block the attack is during installation, noting that third-party security tools may help detect a possible threat and display a warning, but do not have permission to block installation.

articles.title: Sécurité : contournement de mot de passe sur Alpine Linux et musl — Frandroid
articles.text:
Décidément, il semblerait que les briques les plus fondamentales de l’informatique moderne soient toutes pétries de failles de sécurité. À peine remis de la faille PHP qui a mis à terre un bon nombre de serveurs web, voilà que c’est le protocole SSH qui fait des siennes, remarque Ars Technica.
C’est plus spécifiquement une certaine implémentation de cet outil qui est concernée, notamment celle utilisée par Alpine Linux, une distribution largement déployée sur certains NAS, routeurs, objets connectés ou images Docker.
À vos mises à jour
Utilisé pour se connecter à une machine distante via la ligne de commande, le protocole SSH est extrêmement répandu dans le monde Linux. Son implémentation varie de système à système, mais, dans le cas qui nous intéresse, c’est l’interaction entre OpenSSH et musl, une bibliothèque C, qui est vulnérable. D’autres conditions doivent aussi être réunies (un mot de passe hashé via SHA256 ou SHA512 entre autres), mais ces dernières sont assez classiques sur les systèmes se reposant sur Alpine Linux.
Si ces conditions sont remplies, il suffit alors aux pirates de rentrer n’importe quel mot de passe de plus de 256 caractères et la connexion sera validée. De manière très simplifiée, cela se produit parce qu’un mot de passe de cette longueur provoque une erreur qui renvoie le caractère « * » au système, qui est incidemment le signe utilisé pour les comptes ne se reposant pas sur un mot de passe.
Les développeurs et développeuses derrière Alpine Linux et musl ont déjà déployé un correctif qu’il est conseillé d’installer le plus rapidement possible. Si vous ignorez si certains de vos appareils utilisent Alpine Linux, le meilleur conseil est de mettre à jour vos applications Docker, votre NAS, votre télévision connectée ou votre routeur vers la dernière version du système.
Une faille facile à exploiter
La faille est particulièrement gênante, car elle est facile à exploiter. Si peu de machines sont effectivement vulnérables, il est aisé de scanner celles qui le sont et les bombarder de mots de passe trop longs pour voir si elles ouvrent l’accès au système sous-jacent.
    Pour aller plus loin
Linux : une faille critique expose les serveurs à distance
            
La faille est d’ailleurs restée cachée pendant une dizaine d’années avant d’être découverte par Ozgun Kultekin et son armée d’agents d’IA qui a, de son propre aveu, « balancé 17 600 connexions suspectes sur le site. Hachages suspects, comptes piratés, mots de passe bien trop longs. »
Si vous voulez recevoir les meilleures actus Frandroid sur WhatsApp, rejoignez cette discussion.
Pour nous soutenir gratuitement, dites simplement à Google d’ajouter Frandroid à vos sources préférées en cliquant ici.

articles.text:
TGIF. ☀️️
What if promising African businesses, the investors looking for them, and the organisations supporting them could connect more easily? That’s the thinking behind Impact Deals AI, a tech-enabled investment-readiness and investor-matching platform developed by Impact Hub Lagos.
The platform helps businesses assess their investment readiness through structured questionnaires, document submissions, and readiness scoring, making it easier to identify strengths and gaps before approaching investors.
For founders, it’s a clearer path to becoming investment-ready, backed by Impact Hub Lagos’ financial modelling, fundraising advisory, and business support services.
For investors, it’s a way to discover more relevant African investment opportunities aligned with their sector, stage, geography, and ticket-size preferences.
And for accelerators, foundations, and entrepreneurship support organizations, it’s a smarter way to onboard businesses, assess investment readiness, identify support needs, and track program progress.
Building a business? Looking for relevant deal flow? Running an investment-readiness programme? We’d love to hear from you.
Connect with Impact Hub Lagos’ Venture Support & Investment team.
Read smart insights about Francophone Africa’s tech ecosystem—weekly.
banking
NCBA shareholders now own 8.3% of Nedbank
Remember the nine-month banking deal we told you about earlier this week? Well, there’s another interesting twist. Kenya’s NCBA shareholders didn’t just sell their bank to South Africa’s Nedbank. They’ve also become owners of the bank that bought theirs.
What’s new? Former NCBA shareholders now collectively own 8.37% of Nedbank after receiving 43.6 million newly issued shares in the South African lender. They also received KES 23.2 billion ($179 million) in cash.
Explain like I’m new here. Nedbank completed its acquisition of a 66% stake in NCBA and transferred the shares on Tuesday, ending a nine-month process. But this wasn’t an ordinary cash purchase. Under the agreement, NCBA shareholders received 80% of their payment in Nedbank shares and the remaining 20% in cash. Many also kept NCBA shares, allowing them to invest in both banks.
Between the lines: The deal has given some of Kenya’s wealthiest investors, including the Kenyatta and Ndegwa families, a stake in one of South Africa’s largest banking groups. Existing Nedbank shareholders have seen their ownership percentage reduced because the bank issued new shares to fund the acquisition.
Zoom out: This arrangement ties both sets of investors’ fortunes. Nedbank gets control of Kenya’s fifth-largest bank by assets, while participating NCBA shareholders gain exposure to a larger banking group operating across several African markets. They can keep their Nedbank shares and earn dividends or sell them on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE).
The acquisition may be complete, but the financial relationship between buyer and seller is only getting started.

companies
Interswitch expands Uganda’s agency banking network with Housing Finance Bank deal
Have you ever needed to deposit a large amount of cash, but the bank is so far away that you decide to keep the money for a little while? Then, somehow, you start spending it until it disappears? In Uganda, Interswitch is trying to make that journey to the bank less necessary.
What happened? On November 4, Interswitch East Africa and Housing Finance Bank (HFB) launched a partnership that adds the bank to Quickteller’s agency banking network. Customers can deposit money into their HFB accounts through participating agents, withdraw cash using their debit cards at point-of-sale terminals, and check their account balances
Explain like I’m new here: Agency banking is like the agent networks operated by OPay and Moniepoint in Nigeria, using neighbourhood businesses as convenient access points for financial services. Uganda is already seeing the model take off. Bank of Uganda figures show agent banking transactions rose 76.1% to UGX29.4 trillion ($7.2 billion) in 2025, from UGX16.7 trillion ($4.1 billion) in 2024. The number of transactions also rose50.5%, reaching 12.5 million in the year to June 2025.
Why this matters: HFB has about 22 branches across Uganda. Quickteller’s 23,000-strong agent network lets it reach customers beyond those locations without building and maintaining a branch in every town. Interswitch stands to gain, too. More banking services on its network could mean more customers visiting Quickteller agents, more transactions for the platform, and additional business for outlet operators.
The partnership has already processed more than UGX49 billion ($12.1 million) in transactions during its pilot phase, according to HFB’s chief operating officer, Robert Kusiima. The bank has not disclosed how long the pilot lasted, how many customers used it,, or how many transactions made up that figure.
startups
Nairobi financial hub plans $500 million fund to back Kenyan startups
A good startup idea is one thing, but finding someone willing to fundit is another. Building a business is expensive, and when investors become cautious, even promising startups can struggle to raise the money they need to grow.
What happened? The Nairobi International Financial Centre (NIFC), a government-backed initiative established to position Nairobi as a regional financial hub and attract investment into Kenya, plans to establish a Sh65 billion ($500 million) fund to finance local businesses. The government will allocate half of the proposed fund to tech and AI startups, while the other half will support businesses in other sectors.
Explain like I’m new here: Kenyan startups raised Sh126 billion ($984 million) in 2025, outpacing major African markets including Egypt, South Africa and Nigeria. Although it is one of Africa’s most active startup corridors, funding doesn’t always come by. Since becoming operational in 2022, the NIFC has attracted about 40 companies and facilitated Sh26 billion ($200 million) in foreign direct investment. By 2030, it wants to facilitate Sh650 billion ($5 billion) in investment and certify at least 150 firms.
Now comes the hard part: The fund will rely on local and international venture capitalists, with NIFC coordinating fundraising and helping assess which startups receive investment. However, it has not yet selected a co-host or fund manager, and it still needs to raise the money. A $500 million announcement makes for a good headline, but what matters is how much money is eventually raised and mobilised.

articles.title: Stellantis a trouvé une solution pour réduire le prix de ses voitures électriques
articles.text:
Le prix reste une composante déterminante dans l’achat d’un véhicule, y compris les voitures électriques. Si l’autonomie et la capacité de recharge jouent un rôle important dans le processus de décision des acheteurs, le prix est toujours l’argument final. Pour baisser les prix, la chimie de la batterie est une solution, notamment les batteries LFP, mais tous les constructeurs n’avancent pas à la même vitesse. Stellantis, qui utilisait majoritairement des batteries NMC, va passer au LFP dès l’année prochaine. Antonio Filosa, le patron de Stellantis, l’a annoncé lors de la présentation des résultats du troisième trimestre 2026.
Vers une généralisation de la batterie LFP ?
Stellantis n’est pas vraiment en retard sur les voitures électriques. Tous les modèles commercialisés par le groupe en Europe, ou presque, ont une déclinaison électrique, allant de la citadine électrique au grand SUV familial, en passant aussi par des supercars et des voitures sans permis. Il y a une voiture électrique Stellantis pour chaque usage, mais toujours avec une batterie NMC (Nickel, Manganèse et Cobalt).
Toutefois, Stellantis a lancé une ligne de modèles électriques plus abordables qui reposent sur la plateforme Smart Car et utilisent des batteries LFP (Lithium-Fer-Phosphate) de 30, 44 ou 54 kWh, que l’on retrouve dans les Citroën ë-C3, ë-C3 Aircross, Opel Frontera et Fiat Grande Panda.
Ces modèles représentent actuellement l’entrée de gamme du groupe Stellantis en électrique en raison des batteries LFP moins chères à produire. Toutefois, le groupe devrait généraliser cette chimie de batterie dans d’autres véhicules dans le but de faire baisser les prix et de répondre à cette guerre des tarifs lancée par les Chinois et suivie par les autres constructeurs européens.
Une batterie moins coûteuse
Tout l’intérêt d’intégrer des batteries LFP dans ses véhicules réside dans le coût. Ces batteries sont environ 40 % moins chères à produire par kWh qu’une batterie NMC. Quand on sait que la batterie représente 25 à 40 % du coût de production du véhicule, travailler sur une batterie plus abordable a un véritable intérêt pour réduire sensiblement le prix du véhicule.
Stellantis devrait intégrer dès l’année prochaine des batteries LFP dans d’autres de ses véhicules. À commencer par la Fiat 500e, la citadine électrique de segment A, qui utilise actuellement des batteries NMC et affiche un prix de départ de 23 900 euros. Sauf que depuis son lancement en 2020, les autres citadines électriques se sont multipliées et affûtées. Une Renault Twingo est proposée à moins de 20 000 euros, notamment grâce à sa batterie LFP. La Fiat 500e pourrait alors passer à la batterie LFP dès 2027, conformément à ce qu’a annoncé Antonio Filosa, CEO de Stellantis, lors de la présentation des résultats financiers du mercredi 28 octobre 2026 : de nombreux modèles électriques européens de Stellantis allaient adopter des batteries LFP en 2027. Et surtout, le prix de la Fiat 500e pourrait descendre sous les 20 000 euros.
Stellantis devrait aussi profiter du déploiement de la nouvelle plateforme STLA One pour généraliser la batterie LFP dans sa gamme. Cette plateforme sera celle utilisée pour la future 208 électrique, attendue en fin d’année 2027, et qui aura fort à faire pour tenir tête aux Volkswagen ID. Polo, Cupra Raval et Renault 5 E-Tech.

articles.title: Black Friday : ExpressVPN passe à 2,99 €/mois avec 4 mois offerts pour protéger vos achats en ligne — Frandroid
articles.text:
Un smartphone à petit prix, une montre connectée enfin en promotion, une TV OLED qui rentre dans votre budget… À l’approche du Black Friday, prévu le vendredi 27 novembre, les occasions de sortir la carte bancaire ne manquent pas. Mais entre une offre reçue par e-mail et une commande passée sur un Wi-Fi public, mieux vaut prendre quelques précautions avant de valider son panier.
ExpressVPN a justement lancé son offre Black Friday en avance, valable de ce mardi 3 novembre au mardi 17 novembre. Son abonnement Basique bénéficie d’une remise annoncée de 80 %, avec deux ans de protection et quatre mois supplémentaires offerts.
Comptez ainsi 83,66 euros TTC pour les 28 premiers mois, soit 2,99 euros TTC par mois. Les nouveaux utilisateurs disposent également d’une garantie de remboursement de 30 jours.
Faux sites et phishing : un filtre supplémentaire avant de sortir la carte bancaire
Une fausse boutique peut reprendre le nom, le logo et les fiches produits d’une enseigne connue. Un e-mail promotionnel peut aussi renvoyer vers une copie de sa page de connexion. Dans les deux cas, le but est de récupérer les informations que vous saisissez : identifiants, mot de passe ou numéro de carte bancaire.
ExpressVPN intègre un bloqueur de sites malveillants, disponible dès la formule Basique de son abonnement. Il empêche votre appareil de se connecter aux domaines présents dans ses listes de blocage, notamment ceux associés au phishing, aux boutiques frauduleuses et à la diffusion de logiciels malveillants. Lorsqu’un site est répertorié, sa page est bloquée avant de s’afficher.
La fonction doit être activée dans les réglages de protection avancée de l’application, et le VPN doit être connecté pour qu’elle fonctionne. Elle est notamment disponible sur les applications ExpressVPN pour Windows, macOS, Android et iOS.
Une connexion mieux protégée pour faire vos achats
Le VPN, lui, protège les données pendant leur trajet entre votre appareil et le serveur VPN. ExpressVPN crée une connexion chiffrée entre les deux, par laquelle passe votre trafic Internet. Les sites consultés voient alors l’adresse IP du serveur plutôt que votre adresse IP réelle.
Les sites marchands protègent généralement déjà vos informations de paiement grâce au HTTPS, signalé par le cadenas dans la barre d’adresse. ExpressVPN ajoute une protection à votre navigation : il empêche les personnes qui surveillent le réseau utilisé de voir les sites que vous consultez, pendant vos recherches comme au moment de commander.
L’utilisation reste simple : vous ouvrez l’application, puis vous appuyez sur le bouton de connexion. Le kill switch intégré, lorsqu’il est actif, bloque également le trafic Internet si la liaison avec le serveur VPN est interrompue, jusqu’à son rétablissement.
Moins de pistage entre deux boutiques
Comparer des produits laisse aussi des traces. Des services publicitaires peuvent suivre une partie de votre navigation pour connaître vos centres d’intérêt et vous présenter des annonces ciblées.
Vous consultez une paire d’écouteurs sur une boutique, puis des publicités pour ce modèle vous suivent sur d’autres sites ? Des outils publicitaires ont pu repérer les produits qui vous intéressent en suivant votre navigation.
Le bloqueur de traqueurs d’ExpressVPN empêche certains de ces outils de recevoir des informations sur les pages que vous consultez. Il limite ainsi les informations dont les annonceurs disposent pour personnaliser leurs publicités.
ExpressVPN s’engage aussi à ne pas conserver votre historique de navigation ni vos requêtes DNS, conformément à sa politique de non-conservation des journaux d’activité.
Un VPN noté 8/10, quatre mois offerts et 30 jours pour l’essayer
Noté 8/10 par la rédaction de Frandroid, ExpressVPN associe une interface simple à prendre en main et de bonnes performances. Son protocole Lightway est conçu pour établir rapidement la connexion. La bande passante illimitée permet de garder le VPN activé au quotidien, au-delà des achats du Black Friday.
La formule Basique autorise 10 connexions simultanées. Vous pouvez ainsi protéger votre smartphone, votre ordinateur portable et votre tablette avec le même abonnement.
Pour cette opération, les deux ans d’abonnement sont complétés par quatre mois offerts, soit 28 mois pour 83,66 euros TTC en France. La réduction de 80 % annoncée par ExpressVPN est calculée par rapport au prix de son abonnement mensuel. Après cette première période, le renouvellement est automatique à 79,95 euros HT par an, soit 95,94 euros TTC avec une TVA de 20 %, sauf résiliation.
Enfin, les nouveaux clients qui souscrivent sur le site d’ExpressVPN bénéficient d’une garantie de remboursement de 30 jours. Vous pouvez donc essayer le service sur vos appareils et demander un remboursement si celui-ci ne vous convient pas.

articles.title: Real-Time Rail payments system to launch Monday, feds say | BetaKit
articles.text:
Ottawa will begin rolling out its Real-Time Rail (RTR) payments platform on Monday, according to today’s federal budget.
The news: The 2026 budget outlines several announcements related to Canada’s ongoing payments modernization efforts. Chief among them is a plan to roll out the first phase of RTR, an instant-payment system developed by national non-profit Payments Canada, on Nov. 9.
Other announcements include plans for a public consultation in early 2027 on payment modernization “future priorities” and targeted but as-yet-undisclosed amendments to the Retail Payment Activities Act, which is aimed at strengthening Bank of Canada oversight of payment services providers. Additionally, the budget announces plans to develop a pilot project for “the use of voluntary digital credentials” in financial services to help combat identity fraud.
From the source: The C.D. Howe Institute, a not-for-profit think tank, has estimated that the introduction of RTR in Canada will add $3.2 billion in economic gains in the system’s first five years by displacing inefficient means of payment and reducing delays.
The context: Canada remains the only G7 nation without an instant payment rail. RTR is meant to allow Canadians and financial institutions to transfer funds that clear immediately.
Under development since 2015, and nearly seven years past its initial targeted launch of 2019, the federal government telegraphed earlier this year that RTR’s Phase 1 launch was coming in the last quarter of 2026. At that time, several sources familiar with the rollout told BetaKit that it was unlikely any of the Big Six banks in Canada would be participating in RTR’s first phase. Some in Canada’s FinTech community, including Koho’s Daniel Eberhard, criticized that absence, telling BetaKit that RTR would be largely performative without participation from the country’s largest financial institutions. Budget 2026 makes no mention of which institutions will participate in next week’s rollout.
Final thought: While RTR may finally be arriving in Canada after so many years of delays, the payment infrastructure is just one aspect of a larger payments modernization process the federal government has been advertising in recent years. Open banking, another highly anticipated project to modernize Canadian finance, was barely mentioned in the budget outside of government plans to extend data portability to other sectors, but Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne pledged open banking is still on the way during a question period with the media on Thursday.
CORRECTION (11/05/2026): A previous version of this story stated that Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne made remarks on open banking during his House of Commons address. It has been corrected to reflect that the statement was made during a question period with the media.
BetaKit’s Prairies reporting is funded in part by YEGAF, a not-for-profit dedicated to amplifying business stories in Alberta.

articles.title: Garmin Forerunner 70 com 5 ATM cai 38% com cupom no Mercado Livre • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Garmin Forerunner 70 com 5 ATM cai 38% com cupom no Mercado Livre
Garmin Forerunner 70 resiste à água e possui bateria que dura até 28 dias; smartwatch para treinos recebe desconto com cupom no mês da Black Friday
O Garmin Forerunner 70 está saindo por R$ 1.599 no Pix com cupom DESCONTOSESPECIAIS no Mercado Livre. O smartwatch com resistência a até 5 ATM, bateria de longa duração e suporte a atividades esportivas, recebe desconto de 38% sobre o preço original de R$ 2.599 durante o Black November 2026.
O Garmin Forerunner 70 possui um corpo de 43 mm resistente a até 5 ATM, oferecendo proteção a condições extremas e permitindo seu uso em esportes aquáticos, segundo a fabricante. Os apenas 512 MB de espaço interno são dedicados ao SO e não permitem salvar músicas ou instalar apps localmente.
Os sensores especializados do smarwatch cobrem diversas atividades físicas diferentes, como caminhada, corrida e ciclismo, e o modo Garmin Couch traça planos de treino personalizados. Ele também possui medidores do sono, saúde da mulher e oxigenação do sangue, e monitora o consumo de calorias, álcool e cafeína.
Este acessório também pode ser de grande ajuda em situações de risco: no caso de uma emergência médica, ele pode disparar mensagens para contatos pré-determinados, informando a localização exata do usuário para serviços de resgate e pessoas próximas, mas apenas se estiver pareado a um celular.
A tela AMOLED de 1,2″ do Forerunner 70 reproduz imagens com cores bem definidas e brilho forte. O vidro Gorilla Glass 3 protege-a contra pancadas e arranhões.
Sua bateria resiste a até 13 dias de uso no modo smartwatch (5 dias com Always-On ligado), até 28 dias no modo de economia, e até 16 horas com navegação ativa e todos os recursos disponíveis (até 23 horas apenas com o GPS ligado), segundo a fabricante.
O Garmin Forerunner 70 (R$ 1.599 no Pix com cupom DESCONTOSESPECIAIS) suporta iPhone e Android e possui conectividade Bluetooth e GPS multibanda, que determina a posição exata do usuário em tempo real.
Durante todo o mês de novembro (Black November), o Mercado Livre e concorrentes oferecem diversos cupons e ofertas como essa, em antecipação para a Black Friday 2026, em 27 de novembro.
